About Nagpur

A city with a story

Nagpur, popularly known as the Orange City, is one of Maharashtra's most prominent cities. Located in the geographical heart of India, it is known for its rich cultural heritage, historical landmarks, educational institutions and vibrant lifestyle.

01

Heritage

A city enriched with historical monuments and cultural traditions.

02

Education

A growing educational hub with reputed institutions and universities.

03

Identity

Famous for its oranges, geographical significance and unique cultural character.

Famous Landmarks

Places that define Nagpur

From historical monuments to peaceful lakes, discover the places that make our city special.

01

Deekshabhoomi

A significant Buddhist monument and an important symbol of social transformation.

02

Zero Mile Stone

A historic geographical marker associated with the measurement of distances across India.

03

Futala Lake

A popular lakeside destination known for its scenic beauty and evening atmosphere.

04

Sitabuldi Fort

A historic fort situated in the heart of Nagpur, associated with the Battle of Sitabuldi.

05

Raman Science Centre

An interactive science centre that encourages scientific curiosity and learning.

06

Ambazari Lake

A beautiful natural attraction known for its lake and surrounding greenery.

07

Shri Ganesh Temple, Tekdi

A famous temple located on a hill near Nagpur Railway Station.

08

ISKCON Nagpur

Sri Sri Radhagopinath Temple – a serene Krishna temple known for its ornate altar and devotional atmosphere.

09

Lata Mangeshkar Musical Garden

A landscaped city garden with open lawns, winding paths and a striking Nataraja sculpture at its heart.

10

Sakkardara Garden

A green, peaceful garden with a tranquil pond, a wooden bridge pavilion and shaded walks.

11

Gorewada Lake

A calm lakeside spot on the edge of the city, loved for its birdlife and quiet sunrise views.

12

Seminary Hills

A leafy hill area with shaded forest paths and a peaceful railway track running through the trees.

13

Sachee Art Gallery

A creative corner of the city filled with paintings, handicrafts and curated home décor.
